Fault-sensitivity honesty (Objective 7)

The 'Faults Potentially Sensitive To' column on Core_Canaries is deliberately prefixed 'Hypothesized sensitivity (design-basis, not empirically validated)' for all 150 items. These fault-to-item mappings were derived from mechanism-based reasoning about how each fault class (quantization, checkpoint/version regression, tokenizer mismatch, chat-template mismatch, decoding drift, stale LoRA adapter) could plausibly alter the tested behavior -- they have NOT been experimentally validated by actually injecting these faults. This column is supporting metadata only and does not affect subtype assignment or scoring.
